description: This file defines the RooProtectedController class which manages write protection for Roo configuration files by matching file paths against predefined patterns. It includes methods for checking if files are protected, retrieving protected files, annotating paths, and providing instructions and messages related to file protection.

classes.name: RooProtectedController
classes.description: A class that enforces protection patterns on Roo configuration files, providing methods to check, list, and annotate protected files, as well as generate instructions and messages related to file protection.

methods.name: isWriteProtected
methods.description: Checks if a given file path matches any of the protected patterns, indicating it is write-protected.

methods.name: getProtectedFiles
methods.description: Returns a set of file paths from a list that are protected.

methods.name: annotatePathsWithProtection
methods.description: Returns an array of objects indicating whether each path in the input list is protected.

methods.name: getProtectionMessage
methods.description: Provides a message indicating that protected files require approval for modifications.

methods.name: getInstructions
methods.description: Returns formatted instructions about protected file patterns, including a shield symbol.
